# FG-DB-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`job-dead-lettered`](../../ops/runbooks/job-dead-lettered.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_job_that_fails_max_attempts_times_is_dead_and_reported` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: バックグラウンドの処理が完了できませんでした。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: A background task could not be completed. Contact the administrator.
- id: Tugas latar belakang tidak dapat diselesaikan. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

An internal job in forge.jobs died: its work is not done until it is enqueued again. reason=attempts_exhausted: its handler failed max_attempts times; permanent_failure: the handler reported a failure that can never succeed (dead at the first such failure); lease_expired: its last lease expired (worker crashed, run cancelled, hung) with the attempts used up; dead_lettered (forge doctor jobs.dead): a job died within the last 24 h. (Jobs piling up or a reaper that does not run is FG-DB-0017.)

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `reason`, `job_id`, `kind`, `attempts`, `last_error_code` (the code of the last failure; FG-DB-0007 = its lease expired) and `origin_request_id` (the request or event that enqueued it — search the logs for it to follow request → event → job). The job runner logs the cause first, under its own error_code with `job_id` / `kind` / `attempt`, then this event, both with the origin request_id. forge doctor adds `dead_recent` (dead within 24 h, capped). Read the row (read-only): SELECT id, kind, state, attempts, max_attempts, last_error_code, last_error, origin_request_id, created_at, finished_at FROM forge.jobs WHERE id = <job_id>; run `forge doctor --json` (jobs.dead).

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the cause named by last_error_code (its own runbook), then have the work redone by the command that owns the kind: a dead job does not hold its dedup_key, so enqueueing the same work again creates a new job (never edit forge.jobs by hand outside an approved runbook step).
